title: Scranimation
description: When you think of Scratch animations, you probably think of simplistic sprites and characters gliding across the screen. But what if I told you that Scratch has been used to create fully animated cartoons, series, and even *movies?* In this article, “Scranimator” IncognitoOrange discusses the history of animation within Scratch, and how many different Scranimators, time and time again, have pushed the website to its limits.
